h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Singrauli

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Singrauli

items.pText: For a site as far from Vasai as Singrauli, the smartest equipment is the kind that rarely needs a spare part. FunPlay Systems designs and manufactures outdoor playground equipment at our factory in Vasai East, Maharashtra, about 1,140 km away, and supplies schools, colonies and parks across Singrauli by road.

Singrauli, on the Madhya Pradesh and Uttar Pradesh border, is known as an energy hub, with coal mines and large power stations. Many of its colonies and schools are run by the companies that operate them. Share the size of your site, the age of the children and a few photos. We will suggest a mix of equipment that keeps maintenance low and send a layout drawing with the safe play area marked.

props.h2Text: How would you like to start?
props.pText: Turn your playground dreams to reality

richText.heading: Choosing parts that wear least on a remote site

c: Most wear on a playground happens at moving parts. Swing hooks, spring rider springs and merry-go-round bearings are the items that need replacing first, and they carry a one-year warranty. Fixed pieces such as slides,
and decks have no moving parts and need far less attention.

A good balance for a remote colony is a fixed multi play structure as the main piece, with only a few swings or spring riders around it. Keep one or two spare springs or bearings in the colony store, so a worn part can be swapped without waiting. Summers here are very hot and dusty. See our

items.q: Which parts of playground equipment wear out first?
items.a: Moving parts such as springs, bearings and swing hooks. They carry a one-year warranty. Galvanised pipes and roto-moulded parts carry three years and wear far more slowly.

items.q: Can we order spare parts to keep on site?
items.a: Yes. Contact our after-sales team at aftersales@funplaysystems.com or +91 738 530 0921 with the product name and the part you need.

items.q: Do you supply company colonies in Singrauli?
items.a: Yes. We supply company colonies, schools and public bodies. You receive a layout drawing and a detailed quote that can go through your internal approval process.
